subcommands.name: accept-qualification-request
subcommands.description: The AcceptQualificationRequest operation approves a Worker's request for a Qualification.

subcommands.name: approve-assignment
subcommands.description: The ApproveAssignment operation approves the results of a completed assignment.

subcommands.name: associate-qualification-with-worker
subcommands.description: The AssociateQualificationWithWorker operation gives a Worker a Qualification.

subcommands.name: create-additional-assignments-for-hit
subcommands.description: The CreateAdditionalAssignmentsForHIT operation increases the maximum number of assignments of an existing HIT.

subcommands.name: create-hit
subcommands.description: The CreateHIT operation creates a new Human Intelligence Task (HIT).

subcommands.name: create-hit-type
subcommands.description: The CreateHITType operation creates a new HIT type.

subcommands.name: create-hit-with-hit-type
subcommands.description: The CreateHITWithHITType operation creates a new Human Intelligence Task (HIT) using an existing HITTypeID generated by the CreateHITType operation.

subcommands.name: create-qualification-type
subcommands.description: The CreateQualificationType operation creates a new Qualification type, which is represented by a QualificationType data structure.

subcommands.name: create-worker-block
subcommands.description: The CreateWorkerBlock operation allows you to prevent a Worker from working on your HITs.

subcommands.name: delete-hit
subcommands.description: The DeleteHIT operation is used to delete HIT that is no longer needed.

subcommands.name: delete-qualification-type
subcommands.description: The DeleteQualificationType deletes a Qualification type and deletes any HIT types that are associated with the Qualification type.

subcommands.name: delete-worker-block
subcommands.description: The DeleteWorkerBlock operation allows you to reinstate a blocked Worker to work on your HITs.

subcommands.name: disassociate-qualification-from-worker
subcommands.description: The DisassociateQualificationFromWorker revokes a previously granted Qualification from a user.

subcommands.name: get-account-balance
subcommands.description: The GetAccountBalance operation retrieves the Prepaid HITs balance in your Amazon Mechanical Turk account if you are a Prepaid Requester.

subcommands.name: get-assignment
subcommands.description: The GetAssignment operation retrieves the details of the specified Assignment.

subcommands.name: get-file-upload-url
subcommands.description: The GetFileUploadURL operation generates and returns a temporary URL.

subcommands.name: get-hit
subcommands.description: The GetHIT operation retrieves the details of the specified HIT.

subcommands.name: get-qualification-score
subcommands.description: The GetQualificationScore operation returns the value of a Worker's Qualification for a given Qualification type.

subcommands.name: get-qualification-type
subcommands.description: The GetQualificationTypeoperation retrieves information about a Qualification type using its ID.

subcommands.name: list-assignments-for-hit
subcommands.description: The ListAssignmentsForHIT operation retrieves completed assignments for a HIT.

subcommands.name: list-bonus-payments
subcommands.description: The ListBonusPayments operation retrieves the amounts of bonuses you have paid to Workers for a given HIT or assignment.

subcommands.name: list-hi-ts-for-qualification-type
subcommands.description: The ListHITsForQualificationType operation returns the HITs that use the given Qualification type for a Qualification requirement.

subcommands.name: list-hits
subcommands.description: The ListHITs operation returns all of a Requester's HITs.

subcommands.name: list-hits-for-qualification-type
subcommands.description: The ListHITsForQualificationType operation returns the HITs that use the given Qualification type for a Qualification requirement.

subcommands.name: list-qualification-requests
subcommands.description: The ListQualificationRequests operation retrieves requests for Qualifications of a particular Qualification type.

subcommands.name: list-qualification-types
subcommands.description: The ListQualificationTypes operation returns a list of Qualification types, filtered by an optional search term.

subcommands.name: list-review-policy-results-for-hit
subcommands.description: The ListReviewPolicyResultsForHIT operation retrieves the computed results and the actions taken in the course of executing your Review Policies for a given HIT.

subcommands.name: list-reviewable-hits
subcommands.description: The ListReviewableHITs operation retrieves the HITs with Status equal to Reviewable or Status equal to Reviewing that belong to the Requester calling the operation.

subcommands.name: list-worker-blocks
subcommands.description: The ListWorkersBlocks operation retrieves a list of Workers who are blocked from working on your HITs.

subcommands.name: list-workers-with-qualification-type
subcommands.description: The ListWorkersWithQualificationType operation returns all of the Workers that have been associated with a given Qualification type.

subcommands.name: notify-workers
subcommands.description: The NotifyWorkers operation sends an email to one or more Workers that you specify with the Worker ID.

subcommands.name: reject-assignment
subcommands.description: The RejectAssignment operation rejects the results of a completed assignment.

subcommands.name: reject-qualification-request
subcommands.description: The RejectQualificationRequest operation rejects a user's request for a Qualification.

subcommands.name: send-bonus
subcommands.description: The SendBonus operation issues a payment of money from your account to a Worker.

subcommands.name: send-test-event-notification
subcommands.description: The SendTestEventNotification operation causes Amazon Mechanical Turk to send a notification message as if a HIT event occurred, according to the provided notification specification.

subcommands.name: update-expiration-for-hit
subcommands.description: The UpdateExpirationForHIT operation allows you update the expiration time of a HIT.

subcommands.name: update-hit-review-status
subcommands.description: The UpdateHITReviewStatus operation updates the status of a HIT.

subcommands.name: update-hit-type-of-hit
subcommands.description: The UpdateHITTypeOfHIT operation allows you to change the HITType properties of a HIT.

subcommands.name: update-notification-settings
subcommands.description: The UpdateNotificationSettings operation creates, updates, disables or re-enables notifications for a HIT type.

subcommands.name: update-qualification-type
subcommands.description: The UpdateQualificationType operation modifies the attributes of an existing Qualification type, which is represented by a QualificationType data structure.
